heading: Would you buy this?
format: 13px heading; 12px hint; numbered stars and existing accessible choice targets retained.
interpretation: Expression of interest, not an order. Responses predating this wording must remain identified as design ratings in later analysis, not retroactively counted as buying intent.
scope: Copy and presentation only; no stored votes rewritten and no backend changes.
latest_user_direction: Keep the text small. Retain Not for me / Love it and restore stars.
